statement: A family record that cannot be read, or a write of it that cannot be confirmed, issues nothing: the refresh fails (503), never reads the family as absent or the write as done. A missing record refuses the refresh (401).
guards: login:TokenFamiliesTest#an unreadable family record issues nothing
cocache:CoCacheTokenFamilyStoreTest#an unreadable family record issues nothing
cocache:CoCacheTokenFamilyStoreTest#the family table reads a failure as unknown, and no layer changes that
